A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a new donor-acceptors (TPDCDTC) with uniaxially anisotropic structure has been successfully synthesized, which is a promising donor material for vacuum-deposited SMOSC with high efficiency of 3,82% and a high open circuit voltage of 0.93 V.
the coplanar D-π-A structure with uniaxially oriented diphenyl-substitution on DTS unit is a promising structure for efficient vacuum-deposed SMOSC.

the coplanar dithienosilene-based donor material with uniaxially anisotropic molecular structure has been successfully synthesized and used as a donor for efficient SMOSC with C(70) acceptor, which is a promising candidate for vacuum-deposited SMOSC.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the incorporation of coplanar dipenyl-substituted DTS into the donor material is a promising way to improve the efficiency of SMOSC.
the coplanarity between donor and acceptor units in a D-π-A structure is crucial to achieve high performance in vacuum-deposited SMOSC.
the use of the uniaxial D-π-A structure is effective for the fabrication of vacuum-deposited SMOSC with high efficiency.
